summary: Phase 9 dispatch (single-phase, H1): investigated the THREE-part Phase 9 mandate (add sat_timp field to IBranchSaturation, discharge it in IExpandedConsistent_sat, prove intExtractValuation monotone, close truthLemma T-imp sorry). CONCLUSION: Phase 9 as scoped is genuinely BLOCKED, not deflected -- verified against source (Rules.lean, Expansion.lean, Scheme.lean call sites), not assumed. Two INDEPENDENT gaps found, both requiring infrastructure that does not exist yet: (1) FUEL ENTANGLEMENT (shared with the pre-existing intExtractValuation monotonicity STOP-gate at Scheme.lean:442-483): IExpandedConsistent_sat's sole call site (intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat's none-leaf case, Scheme.lean ~:1467) operates on bPers = applyPersistenceFixpoint bh edgesH (fuel'+1), where fuel'+1 IS the outer intExpandBranches.go recursion's own remaining step-count (the same Nat intExpMeasure_step_lt bounds), reused verbatim as the inner T-imp persistence loop's fuel. applyPersistenceFixpoint (Expansion.lean:133-139) only self-certifies a GENUINE fixpoint of applyAllTImpRules when its length-equality check fires before fuel runs out; there is no existing bound proving 'rounds needed <= remaining fuel at this call site' -- that requires a NEW step-lt-style lemma for applyPersistenceFixpoint's OWN recursion (distinct from intExpMeasure_step_lt, which bounds outer alpha/beta/world-creation steps only), comparable in size to Phase 7 itself, and is exactly the intExpMeasure <= fuel invariant-maintained-throughout-the-induction fact Phase 10 is already scoped to build (the same gap underlies Scheme.lean's fuel-0 sorry, one level up). (2) DETERMINACY GAP (independent of (1), not previously documented in reports 08/09): even GRANTING a genuine fixpoint, intTImpRule (Rules.lean:174-187) only ever adds T(psi)@w' when T(phi)@w' is already present, so a fixpoint certifies exactly 'T(phi)@w' in b -> T(psi)@w' in b' for every accessible w' -- NOT the report-09-proposed sat_timp disjunction 'F(phi)@w' in b OR T(psi)@w' in b', which must hold unconditionally (truthLemma's T-imp goal supplies IForces val w' phi' semantically, not T(phi')@w' in b, so the weaker fixpoint fact cannot be substituted). Bridging '~(T(phi)@w' in b)' to 'F(phi)@w' in b' needs a determinacy/bivalence fact -- every subformula of Sub(phi0) is either T- or F-tagged at every branch-accessible world -- that no existing IBranchSaturation field or invariant establishes. Given the strict no-sorry/no-vacuous/no-new-axiom invariant, NEITHER the sat_timp field addition NOR the monotonicity proof NOR the truthLemma T-imp close could be completed sorry-free in this dispatch; attempting the field addition without a genuine discharge would force introducing a NEW sorry at IExpandedConsistent_sat's construction site (currently sorry-free), which is forbidden. ACTUAL WORK DONE (real, verified, not analysis-only): added a new STOP-gate documentation block to Scheme.lean (mirroring the project's own existing STOP-gate convention for the monotonicity blocker), recording both gaps with full file:line evidence, committed `969782b5`. Scoped build GREEN (both Completeness modules, 807/807 jobs); no Scheme.lean proof code touched; zero new sorries; zero new axioms (comment-only change).
